kai: Heads-up — I noticed inconsistent enum examples in the API ref. The schema shows `status: "active" | "inactive"` but live API returns numeric codes (1/0). Sample JS & Python snippets use the string values which breaks our SDKs.

jessica: ugh, yeah that'll confuse users. Can you drop an example request/response? :eyes: 

kai: sure — minimal curl from the live service:

kai: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/thing -d '{"name":"x","status":1}'
# response
{"id":"abc","status":1}
```

kai: current docs snippet (bad):

kai: ```json
{"name":"x","status":"active"}
```

tom: This is a doc bug + SDK snippet bug. We should: (1) update OpenAPI to show numeric codes, (2) add a mapping table explaining code=>display, (3) add migration note for teams relying on strings.

chloe: I'll update the OpenAPI and examples. Want me to add a small helper in the JS snippet to map codes to display names?

jessica: yes please. Also add a short "if you upgraded from <=v2" note. Mention backwards compat fallback behavior from server (it still accepts strings for now, but will deprecate).

kai: server currently accepts both (strings and ints) but logs warn and send deprecation header `X-Deprecation: status-string`. We should call that out.

docs-bot: automated docs check failed: examples mismatch in /spec/paths/~1thing/post, see https://ci.redwood.ai/9876/logs

chloe: thx. I'll push a PR with OpenAPI tweak + examples + small JS helper

kai: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — includes curl/python/js snippets and a migration blurb

jessica: reviewing now. If all good, we should add a short release note and a link from the SDK changelog.

tom: also add a unit test for docs generator to assert example request matches example schema.

jessica: ok merged after minor tweaks :thumbsup:

kai: thanks all — closing this thread once release note is posted.
